name: 3W Clinic Charcoal Cleansing Foam
description:
3W Charcoal Cleansing Foam - 100ml

A purifying facial foam wash.Features a hypoallergenic, non-drying formula.Creates a rich lather to dissolve makeup residue & remove impurities & dead cells.Contains charcoal to eliminate sebum in pores.Leaves skin clean, purified & shine-free.

Ingredients:
Water, Potassium Hydroxide, Lauric Acid, Myristic Acid, Glycerin, Lauramide DEA, Glyceryl Stearate, Phenoxyethanol, Methylparaben, Propylparaben, Disodium EDTA, Sorbitan Olivate, Rosa Hybrid Flower Water(0.1%), Freesia Refracta Extract, PEG-100Stearate, Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract, Punica Granatum Fruit Extract, Coca midopropyl Betaine, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Stearic acid, Stearicacid, Fragrance, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Perfume, Lilium Tigrinum Extract, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Extract, Stearic Acid, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, CI 42090, Charcoal Powd er(0.1%), Portulaca Oleracea Extract, Nelumbium Speciosum Flower Extract, Hydrolyzed Collagen(100mg), PEG-100 Stearate, CI 19140, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Flower Extract, Bambusa Vulgaris Extract, Phellinus Linteus Extract
